AddMenuEntryRequest.description: Body for adding a recipe to a menu.

pinRevision.description: Pin the current revision instead of following later edits.

plannedDate.description: Day inside the period, or null for "some time in the period".

servings.description: Portions, 1 to 24; the recipe's servings when null.

AdjustmentRequest.description: Records an explicit immutable inventory adjustment.

AttentionListResponse.description: Lots that need attention, most urgent first; at most 100.

ChangeMenuEntryRequest.description: Body for changing a menu entry; every field is replaced.

plannedDate.description: Day inside the period, or null for flexible.

reserveIngredients.description: Whether the meal reserves pantry quantity; unchanged when omitted.

ChangeMenuPlanRequest.description: Body for renaming a menu or changing its period.

endDate.description: Last day; dated meals must still fit.

CompleteRecipeExecutionRequest.description: Completion body. Every field is the user's confirmed choice; none is inferred server-side.

CreateLotRequest.description: Creates one manually entered, user-owned inventory lot. `AutoRemoveOn`: the day after which the lot is removed automatically (PLAN-0056).

CreateMenuPlanRequest.description: Body for creating a draft menu.

endDate.description: Last day, inclusive; at most 31 days in all.

CreateRecipeRequest.description: Body for writing a recipe from scratch.

DeriveRecipeRequest.description: Body for deriving a new recipe.

derivationReason.description: How the new recipe differs, at most 200 characters.

sourceExecutionId.description: Completed cooking session of the parent the changes come from.

version.description: Opaque profile version matching the ETag header when a profile exists; null when no profile exists yet.

EquipmentItemDto.description: Equipment item request DTO. Order is the array position; response exposes sortOrder.

ListLotsResponse.description: Returns a cursor-paginated owner-scoped inventory list.

LotAttentionResponse.description:
Advisory attention for a lot, evaluated at response time in the user's time zone. It explains
itself with stable reason codes and never claims that food is safe.

LotCommitmentResponse.description: One lot with its protection and the meals counting on it; quantities in Unit.

LotHistoryResponse.description:
Returns one immutable lifecycle transaction or a safe metadata-correction audit projection.
Metadata projections expose only changed field names and never values, notes, tokens, or other
private request content.

LotLifecycleResponse.description: Returns the lot's lifecycle state, the most recent instant of each transition, and its source lot when derived.

LotProtectionRequest.description: Body (and projection) of a lot protection.

minimumQuantity.description: Quantity to keep, in the lot's unit, for `minimum`.

LotProvenanceResponse.description:
Returns preparation batches that consumed or produced one owned lot. Each direction returns at
most fifty batches; its truncation flag is true when additional older relationships exist.

LotReservationResponse.description: Quantity of a lot reserved for one meal.

LotResponse.description: Returns the current representation of an inventory lot, including its automatic removal date (PLAN-0056).

LotTransitionResponse.description: Returns the lifecycle facts of a transition history entry; the related lot is the other side of a partial transition.

MealPreparationReminderResponse.description: Something to do before a planned meal.

kind.description: `buy` (a required ingredient is not covered), `thaw` (a reserved lot is frozen), or `use_by` (a reserved lot's date falls before the meal; advisory).

quantity.description: Missing quantity (`buy`) or quantity reserved from the lot.

unit.description: `Gram`, `Milliliter`, or `Unit`, when there is a quantity.

MealPreparationResponse.description: Pre-meal reminders for the dated meals of menus in use (PLAN-0029 Phase 4). Read-only.

MealReadinessResponse.description: A meal's readiness: `ready` or `missing`, with what is missing.

MenuEntryResponse.description:
One meal. Status is `planned`, `skipped`, `cooking`, or
`cooked`; the last two come from the cooking session started from it
(ExecutionId).

MenuPlanResponse.description: A menu with its meals, ordered by day (flexible last) and meal.

MenuPlanSummaryResponse.description: Menu list row; Status is `draft`, `accepted`, or `archived`.

MenuPlanningSlotRequest.description: A slot of an owned menu.

plannedDate.description: Day inside the menu's period, or null for flexible.

MissingIngredientResponse.description: An ingredient a meal still lacks.

NameSuggestionResponse.description: A suggested pantry product name (PLAN-0056 Phase 4).

PackageSizeRequest.description: Body (and response) for a shopping item's package size.

itemKey.description: Item key from the shopping list; its unit is the size's unit.

size.description: Size of one package, greater than zero and at most 100,000; null forgets it.

PreferenceCommandAction.description: Explicit preference or restriction command action.

version.description: Opaque profile version matching the ETag header when a profile exists; null when no profile exists yet.

PreparationInputRequest.description: Consumes one measured parent lot using its resource-bound opaque current version.

PreparationInputResponse.description: Returns one consumed input's actual quantity in immutable preparation provenance.

PreparationOutputProductRequest.description: References either an existing owned product or a new normalized product for all v1 preparation outputs.

PreparationOutputRequest.description: Stores one portion of a preparation batch's declared yield.

PreparationOutputResponse.description: Returns one produced lot and its prepared-component metadata.

PreparationResponse.description: Returns an owner-visible preparation batch and its immutable input/output provenance.

PrepareComponentsRequest.description: Creates an authoritative manual preparation transaction with all parent and output lines.

PreparedLotMetadataResponse.description: Returns prepared-component metadata attached to an authoritative output lot.

PreparedShelfLifeEvidenceRequest.description: Supplies advisory shelf-life evidence for one prepared output without claiming a guarantee.

errors.description: Field-level validation messages keyed by request field name.

traceId.description: Correlation identifier suitable for support without exposing private request data.

ProfileFieldAction.description: Progressive field action. absent is only valid for PUT replace semantics.

ProfileFieldDurability.description: Only durable mutations are accepted on profile endpoints.

ProfileResponse.description: Full profile response with progressive defaults and an explicit existence flag.

createdAt.description: Persisted profile creation timestamp; null when profileExists is false.

profileExists.description: True when a durable profile row is persisted for the authenticated owner.

updatedAt.description: Persisted profile last-update timestamp; null when profileExists is false.

version.description: Opaque profile version matching the ETag header when a profile exists; null when no profile exists yet.

QuantityRequest.description: Represents exactly one inventory quantity mode supplied by an API client.

QuantityResponse.description: Returns a measured or qualitative quantity without mixing the two modes.

archived.description: True to archive, false to bring it back to the library.

RecipeCandidateResponse.description: HTTP projection of one cook-now candidate.

servings.description: Servings the quantities are written for, 1 to 24.

RecipeCookingEntryResponse.description: One finished cooking session: Status is `Completed` or `Abandoned`.

RecipeDetailResponse.description: HTTP projection of one revision of an owned recipe with its library state.

archivedAt.description: Archive instant, or null while in the library.

changeReason.description: Reason given for an edited revision.

currentRevisionNumber.description: Latest revision; differs from RevisionNumber when an older revision is shown.

derivationReason.description: How a derived recipe differs from its parent.

isFavorite.description: Whether the owner marked it as a favorite.

parentRevisionNumber.description: Parent revision a derived recipe started from.

servings.description: Servings the quantities are written for.

thumbnailVisualJson.description: Thumbnail descriptor; `{}` for recipes written by the owner.

quantity.description: Amount used this time (required for `quantity`, optional for `substitute`).

substituteName.description: What was used instead (1–120 characters), for `substitute`.

RecipeExecutionAdjustmentResponse.description: One ingredient change made while cooking (PLAN-0042 Phase 2).

quantity.description: Amount used this time, in the proposal line's unit.

RecipeExecutionAdjustmentsRequest.description: Request body replacing a session's ingredient adjustments; an empty list clears them.

RecipeExecutionConsumptionRequest.description: One confirmed lot consumption in the lot's canonical unit (`Gram`, `Milliliter`, `Unit`).

version.description: The lot version from the proposal; a changed lot fails with 412.

portions.description: Portions stored, 1 to the portions cooked.

RecipeExecutionPantryLotResponse.description: An active measured pantry lot the user can pick.

RecipeExecutionProposalLineResponse.description: One proposal line; `status` is `ready`, `insufficient`, `lot_unavailable`, `not_tracked`, or `skipped` (left out this time). `Adjustment` is the session's change to it (`substitute`, `quantity`, `skip`), and `OriginalName` the recipe's name when substituted.

RecipeExecutionReservationResponse.description: Quantity of a lot another menu meal counts on.

RecipeExecutionResponse.description: One recipe execution. `status` is `InProgress`, `Completed`, or `Abandoned`; `proposal` is present while in progress; `adjustments` are the session's ingredient changes (PLAN-0042 Phase 2).

isFavorite.description: Whether the recipe is a favorite.

RecipeGenerationSessionResponse.description: HTTP projection of one cook-now generation session.

RecipeHistoryResponse.description: A recipe's revisions and finished cooking sessions, newest first.

RecipeIngredientRequest.description: One ingredient row; IngredientId keeps an existing row and its pantry link.

ingredientId.description: Identifier from the base revision, or null for a new row.

optional.description: Whether the dish works without it.

RecipeStageRequest.description: One stage; StageId keeps an existing stage and its dependencies.

instructions.description: Instructions, at most 2000 characters; line breaks separate steps.

sensoryCues.description: Up to six signs of doneness.

stageId.description: Identifier from the base revision, or null for a new stage.

RecipeSummaryResponse.description: HTTP projection of one library row.

archivedAt.description: Archive instant, or null while in the library.

isFavorite.description: Whether the owner marked it as a favorite.

lastCookedAt.description: Completion instant of the latest session.

lastRating.description: Rating given in the latest session, if any.

oneOf.description: Dish image of the current revision (PLAN-0030).

RecipeThumbnailResponse.description:
A recipe's dish image (PLAN-0030): `ready` with a same-origin Url,
`pending` while it is generated, or `none`, which shows the placeholder.

smallUrl.description: Card-size (480 × 270 WebP) image URL when ready, for recipe lists.

url.description: Full-size (1024 × 576 WebP) image URL when ready; it changes when the image changes, so it may be cached.

RequestCandidatesRequest.description: Optional body for requesting candidates; without it the request is cook-now.

oneOf.description: The person's direction for the three candidates (PLAN-0056).

ReservationsResponse.description: Pantry commitments from From; read-only, never changes physical quantity.

ReviseRecipeRequest.description: Body for saving an edit as a new revision.

sourceExecutionId.description: Completed cooking session of this recipe the edit comes from.

SavedCandidateResponse.description: A candidate the owner saved for later (PLAN-0056 Phase 3).

candidate.description: The candidate as it was suggested.

SelectCandidateRequest.description: HTTP body for selecting one cook-now candidate.

candidateId.description: Stable candidate identifier from the generation session.

SessionResponse.description:
Returns the Cocinaris internal user identifier, request-specific CSRF token, and safe profile session projection
for a backend-managed browser session. OIDC access and refresh tokens are intentionally never present in this response.

ShoppingCheckRequest.description: Body (and response) for checking a shopping line.

checked.description: Whether the line is checked off.

itemKey.description: Item key from the shopping list.

ShoppingItemResponse.description: One shopping line; quantities are in Unit (`Gram`, `Milliliter`, `Unit`).

availableIsEstimate.description: Whether AvailableQuantity includes an estimated pantry amount.

checked.description: Whether the owner checked it off.

expectedRemainder.description: What those packages leave after the menu, in Unit; null with PackageCount.

itemKey.description: Key to check the line off.

packageCount.description: Whole packages that cover ToBuyQuantity; null without a package size or with nothing to buy.

packageSize.description: Package size the owner confirmed for this item, in Unit (PLAN-0029 Phase 4); null when none was confirmed.

requiredQuantity.description: What the meals need in all.

storeSection.description: Store section to group the line by: `produce`, `butcher_fish`, `dairy_eggs`, `bakery`, `dry_goods`, `drinks`, or `other` (PLAN-0037 Phase 3).

toBuyQuantity.description: What is left to buy, never negative; no package size is assumed.

ShoppingListResponse.description: A menu's shopping list. Read-only: it never reserves or changes the pantry.

items.description: Lines, ordered by category and name.

mealCount.description: Meals still to cook that were included.

ShoppingUseResponse.description: One meal that needs a shopping line.

missingQuantity.description: What this meal still lacks after the pantry is allocated in plan order.

optional.description: Whether the recipe marks it optional.

StartRecipeExecutionRequest.description: Optional body for starting an execution.

menuEntryId.description: Menu entry the session starts from (PLAN-0029); the entry then shows as cooking, and as cooked once completed.

servings.description: Portions to cook, 1 to 24; the recipe's servings when omitted.

SuggestionGuidanceRequest.description:
Direction for a suggestion request (PLAN-0056). Closed codes only; unknown codes are rejected.
Required lots must be used by every candidate; excluded lots are never sent to the AI.

excludedLotIds.description: Pantry lots to leave out entirely (at most 50).

requiredLotIds.description: Pantry lots every candidate must use (at most 5).

time.description: `quick` (20 minutes or less) or `medium` (45 or less).

TodayMenuEntryResponse.description: A meal of an accepted menu for the requested day.

TransitionRequest.description:
Applies one lifecycle transition. A quantity in the lot's unit makes it partial: that quantity
moves into a new derived lot that takes the transition, and the source keeps the remainder.

UpdateLotRequest.description: Corrects mutable lot metadata without accepting any authoritative owner identifier. `AutoRemoveOn` replaces the removal date (null clears it).
